name: @playliquid/platform-contracts
description: PlayLiquid GameOS platform capability contracts (PL-004). The typed capability surface of every GameOS platform service (R7, lock 17): leaderboard, multiplayer, replay, rewards, achievements, social, analytics, moderation and integrity — typed request/response contracts, game-declared semantic event vocabulary (lock 18), policy descriptors, entitlement/economy idempotency (R10), probabilistic integrity evidence (R11/E11), tenant isolation and least privilege (R20), and pure cross-capability policy validators. Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no storage, no service implementations.
